headline: Anthropic Narrows Quarterly Net Loss Ahead of Planned IPO
summary: Artificial intelligence company Anthropic reported that its quarterly net loss narrowed to $23.29 billion, while revenue surged ahead of an expected initial public offering.
why: Anthropic is a prominent artificial intelligence developer backed by major enterprise players, making its financial metrics closely watched indicators of sector profitability and IPO appetite.

impacts.name: Anthropic
impacts.why: Narrowing losses and higher revenues improve the financial profile ahead of a public listing.
